name: Living In The Past
overview: Scripture warns against dwelling on the past or longing for former days, as seen in Ecclesiastes 7:10 and Isaiah 43:18, which counsel believers not to fixate on what has been but to move forward with wisdom. Instead, we are called to remember God's ongoing faithfulness and new mercies each morning (Lamentations 3:23) and to bless the Lord without forgetting His benefits (Psalms 103:2). Jesus emphasizes the necessity of steadfast commitment to the kingdom of God, warning that looking back while following Him disqualifies one from His service (Luke 9:62). Believers are urged to cast off darkness and put on the armor of light, living in the present hope rather than the shadows of the past (Romans 13:12).
